defaultPrompt: Interview me to clarify my requirements.
Critically review your previous answer and correct errors.
Juniorize your previous answer for a junior employee.
Prepare a handoff from this conversation.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial, skills-only toolkit with four workflows adapted from selected Matt Pocock skills, a conversation-context filter, an original critical-review skill, and Juniorize for adapting expert-level answers and documents for junior employees while preserving accuracy. Instructions are in English; responses follow your language. No runtime scripts required.
interface.shortDescription: Clarify, review, juniorize and hand off

name: clarity-toolkit
description: Interview requirements, prepare questionnaires, explain confusing messages, hand off context, filter conversation traces, critically revise answers, and juniorize expert content for less-experienced employees.
